text:
Oliver G.: Hi all - I submitted my resignation this morning. Last day will be Mon Oct 7. I'm on sponsored visa and remote from Berlin. Need help with visa offboarding docs, final paycheck timing, health continuation options (if any), laptop + phone return, and access removal schedule. Also would like an exit interview.
People Ops: Thanks for the heads up, Oliver. We'll coordinate with Visa Team and Benefits. Quick notes: benefits typically run to month-end (coverage through 2024-10-31 if last day is Oct 7). We'll confirm any country-specific continuation vs local rules. Can you confirm your shipping address for devices?
Oliver G.: Address is Hauptstrasse 21, 10115 Berlin. I have one company laptop and an Android phone. Also I still have corporate housing paperwork, will that affect final pay or deposit return?
Ben (Payroll): Hi Oliver - deposit returns for housing are handled by Facilities and Payroll will adjust final payout if applicable. Final salary and any accrued vacation payout will be processed on the next pay run after termination (for EU payroll that is Oct 10). Submit expense reports by Oct 3 to be included. DM me for a quick payout estimate.
Visa Team: For sponsored employees we provide an official termination letter and any necessary documentation for immigration authorities. We'll prepare a letter and a checklist for German Ausländerbehörde actions. Expect the docs within 5 business days. Also please let us know if you need a reference letter.
Sana - IT: Oliver - we'll send a prepaid DHL label to your email. Please factory reset the phone and backup personal files. For the laptop: remove any personal SSH keys and unpair bluetooth devices. We'll wipe devices upon receipt. Ship YubiKey (if any) in separate envelope marked "security token".
Oliver G.: I have a YubiKey, will ship that separately. Also do I need to transfer ownership of any GCP projects? I maintain one dev bucket with training data.
Security Bot: Reminder: transfer ownership of any cloud projects or set a service account owner prior to offboard. We'll run an access scan 4 days before termination and revoke keys on last day. Please add @Sana and @People Ops as co-owners on any critical resources.
People Ops: Action items so far: 1) Visa Team prepare termination letter and immigration checklist (Visa Team). 2) Oliver confirm shipping address (done). 3) Sana send label and deprovision plan (Sana). 4) Ben calculate final payout including housing deposit adjustment (Ben). 5) Security Bot run pre-disable audit (Security Bot). 6) Schedule exit interview (People Ops).
Sana - IT: Tentative deprovision timeline:
```
2024-10-07 09:00 CEST - block new device enrollments
2024-10-07 13:00 CEST - revoke elevated GCP/IAM roles
2024-10-07 23:59 CEST - full account disable (email + SSO)
```
We'll delay full disable by up to 48 hours if you need to finish handoffs.
Oliver G.: Can we delay full disable 24 hours? I have one scheduled deploy at 10:30am on my last day I can hand off earlier if needed. I'll push a handoff note and assign a backup.
Ben (Payroll): Noted on deploy. PTO payout follows policy; please confirm your accrued days in the HR portal so I can include them.
Visa Team: We'll include standard termination letter and a note for German authorities about employer contribution periods. If you prefer, we can send a separate PDF you can present locally.
People Ops: When would you like the exit interview? Tue Oct 8 or Wed Oct 9? 30 mins.
Oliver G.: Wed Oct 9 morning works best. Also yes please on a reference note for local authorities.
Sana - IT: Return label emailed (ticket IT-3344). Pickup scheduled Oct 9. We'll mark YubiKey separate.
Security Bot: Pre-disable access scan scheduled for Oct 3. Please confirm any shared passwords stored in team vaults to rotate after handoff.
Oliver G.: Will rotate shared vault creds tonight and add handoff doc in repo with deploy steps and incident runbook. Thanks everyone.
People Ops: We'll send COBRA/continuation-like info and immigration docs within 5 business days and calendar invite for exit interview Wed Oct 9 09:30 CEST. Closing the loop here once all items complete.
Oliver G.: Thanks all  heart
